levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Confuses or cannot restate most of the five symbols.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Correctly restates at least four of the five symbols.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Correctly restates all five and explains a real consequence for at least one.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Cannot interpret new labels without direct help.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Correctly interprets at least two of the three new labels.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Correctly interprets all three and names how they figured out the hardest one.

lookFors: Explanations are in the learner's own words, not a copied definition.
At least one real consequence is named specifically, not generically.
Reflection names an actual strategy used, not 'I just knew it.'

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
